app.title: Waste Your Tokens
app.description: The most satisfying way to burn LLM API tokens

duo.caption: Duo: two parallel streams, two random prompts per cycle (default is Solo, one stream). Toggle off while not burning.

stream.title: Stream
stream.caption: OpenAI-style streaming. Random prompts; rounds run until you click Stop. LaTeX in output: $$...$$, \[...\], or \(...\). Token counts from usage or a length estimate. Transient errors are retried. Reasoning and output stay cached locally; a new request does not clear them until the first token arrives. Only “Clear” removes them. Refreshed content persists.
stream.captionDuo: Duo: two API streams in parallel (two random prompts per cycle). Stopping applies to both. Each panel can download its own output. Caching, LaTeX, and retries are the same as solo.

impact.title: Environmental Impact
impact.subtitle: Every token burned leaves a mark on the planet. Here's what yours looks like.

milesDriven.label: Miles Driven
milesDriven.detail: Equivalent CO₂ from driving an average car

treesToOffset.label: Trees to Offset
treesToOffset.detail: Trees needed to absorb this CO₂

smartphonesCharged.label: Smartphones Charged
smartphonesCharged.detail: Equivalent to fully charging this many phones

googleSearches.label: Google Searches
googleSearches.detail: Same emissions as this many searches

streamingHours.label: Streaming Hours
streamingHours.detail: Equivalent to streaming video for this long

impact.disclaimer: Estimates based on Patterson et al. (2022), EPA (2024), Carbon Trust, and Arbor Day Foundation data. Actual emissions vary by data center energy source, model size, and hardware efficiency.

history.empty: No burn history yet. Start burning to see records here.

settings.title: Configuration
settings.subtitle: Set up your API provider and preferences. Prompts are randomly generated to maximize token waste.
settings.apiKeyHint: Encrypted locally with AES-256-GCM. Sent directly to the API provider.
settings.baseUrlHint: OpenAI-Chat-Completions base URL — the same as the OpenAI SDK `baseURL` (everything before `/chat/completions`). Trailing slashes are auto-removed.
settings.thinkingHint: Intensity is mapped per provider (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, etc.). o-series models always use max completion only.
settings.maxOutputNote: Max completion tokens are always set to the highest allowed (up to 128k) to maximize burn — this is not configurable.
